Global Accounts Payable (AP) at Netflix sits within Finance Procurement Operations, alongside Business Partner (Procurement), Supplier Management Operations and Strategic Operations. AP processes ~ 300K invoices and disburses ~29B annually.


We are seeking a Manager of Accounts Payable to lead our APAC AP team. This team is responsible for invoice processing and resolution, payments, and AP process improvement and strategy. The APAC AP organization is based in Singapore and supports stakeholders across multiple countries in APAC. You will oversee the end-to-end operations for these teams and partner closely with AP leaders in other regions to design and implement a global, cross-regional coverage and business continuity model that optimally utilizes our global resources. You will also help shape the strategic direction of the AP organization and manage relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.


Your focus will be on scaling the team and its workflows to: 1) Ensure compliance and excellent customer service; 2) Reduce fraud and operational risk; 3) Drive process efficiency and standardization

— all while maintaining accuracy and safeguarding the company’s resources.


This position is based in our Singapore office and reports to the Sr. Manager of Accounts Payable.


Responsibilities:

  •  Provide strategic leadership and oversight of the APAC Accounts Payable function, including invoice processing, invoice resolution/dispute management, and payments across multiple APAC countries (~ 8-10 countries) 
  • Serve as APAC Payments process owner, defining and maintaining payment best practices, standards, and controls in close partnership with regional AP leaders/Global POC, Treasury, FinTech and Internal Audit 
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a seasoned APAC AP team (located in Singapore), responsible for invoice support, resolution, payments, and tax compliance
  • Own people management activities for the APAC AP team, including hiring, onboarding, goal setting, performance management & career development and business continuity planning
  • Safeguard company assets, prevent fraud, and ensure compliance with financial regulations and policies
  • Identify, drive, and implement opportunities for process improvements and automation. Build scalable workflows that can be applied across an expanding geographic footprint
  • Drive adoption of technology advancements that will help scale and transform the AP org
  • Partner closely with the regional AP leaders as well as with leaders across FPO (Procurement Business Partners, Supplier Management, and Supplier Diversity) to ensure alignment and direction toward the overall vision/strategy
  • Foster a positive and inclusive team environment that encourages collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning and growth
  • Collaborate with key cross-functional stakeholders in Engineering, Accounting, Finance, Tax and Treasury departments
  • Collaborate and support Sr. Manager (functional) and Director (local leader) on key leadership initiatives or projects, including development and maintenance of AP controls and standardization/best practices over the payables process:
    • Monthly AP close oversight
    • Process flow and internal control documentation
    • Regulatory reporting
    • Collaboration with internal and external auditors
    • Business continuity planning
    • Review and approval of all regular and out of cycle payment runs
    • APAC Finance Leadership meeting contributions
  • Develop, implement and monitor performance metrics and service level agreements
  • Collaborate and contribute toward successful operational design and execution of our Center of Excellence (COE) strategy  

Skills & Experience: 

  • Strong leadership skills and decision-making as well as proven ability to drive through ambiguity to form alignment and create clarity and direction
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills for successful collaboration and relationship-building
  • Experience presenting to different levels of audience and ability to adjust the content and context accordingly
  • Enthusiasm for collaboration and a willingness to work across departments and companies to establish effective working relationships
  • Ability to utilize metrics to measure and improve performance
  • Experience in working with distributed teams
  • Experience in guiding analysts in key focus areas to become informed via data on key focus areas, success metrics and opportunities
  • Understanding of SOX compliance rules and guidelines, GAAP, and the P2P process
  • Experience with implementing process improvements and leveraging technology to streamline AP operations
  • Proven track record of successfully managing large scope operations and complex payment processes
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple competing tasks and demands in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Curiosity and passion for learning, taking calculated risks and pivoting when appropriate
  • Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint; Knowledge of cloud-related ERPs systems a plus (Workday experience a plus)

Behind every great story is a team of people enabling creators to do their best work. Our Production Finance team partners with filmmakers and production partners to bring Netflix Originals to life while ensuring financial excellence, operational rigor, and responsible stewardship of production investments.

If you're passionate about storytelling, love solving complex business problems, and thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments, we'd love to meet you.

The Opportunity

As an Associate – Production Finance, you'll be a key business partner supporting Netflix's growing slate of original productions in India.

This is much more than a finance role. You'll work at the intersection of finance, production, and strategy—partnering with internal teams and production companies to help productions make informed financial decisions from development through delivery.

You'll gain exposure to every stage of the production lifecycle while helping ensure our productions are financially sound, operationally efficient, and positioned for success.

What You'll Do

Partner with Productions

  • Work closely with production companies, line producers, production accountants, production auditors and internal Netflix teams throughout the lifecycle of a production.

  • Build trusted relationships with creative, production, legal, business affairs, tax, accounts payable, and external stakeholders to ensure smooth financial operations.

  • Support production partners by providing guidance on Netflix's financial policies, reporting expectations, and production finance processes.

Drive Financial Excellence

  • Review and analyze production budgets, cost reports, cash flows, and forecasts.

  • Monitor production spend against approved budgets and identify financial risks, trends, and opportunities early.

  • Partner with productions to develop accurate Estimates to Complete (ETCs) and final cost projections.

  • Perform variance analysis and communicate meaningful insights that support business decisions.

  • Review invoices, funding requests, and production payments for accuracy and compliance.

Deliver Meaningful Insights

  • Go beyond validating numbers by identifying cost optimization opportunities and operational efficiencies.

  • Analyze production schedules, resource utilization, and spending patterns to proactively highlight financial risks and recommendations.

  • Prepare concise financial summaries and presentations for internal stakeholders to support investment decisions.

Strengthen Financial Operations

  • Map production costs to Netflix's Chart of Accounts and maintain accurate financial records.

  • Update production data across Netflix's internal systems and reporting tools.

  • Partner with auditors and production accountants to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant financial reporting.

  • Help improve reporting processes, financial controls, and operational efficiencies across productions.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who enjoys working with people just as much as they enjoy working with numbers. You are someone who is naturally curious, asks thoughtful questions, and isn't satisfied with simply reconciling numbers—you want to understand the story behind them.

You'll be successful in this role if you have:

  • 7+ years of experience in Production Finance, Production Accounting, Production Management, or a similar role within the film, television, or media industry.

  • Strong understanding of production budgeting, cost reporting, forecasting, and production accounting.

  • Experience working with production companies, studios, line producers, or production accountants.

  • Excellent financial analysis and problem-solving skills with strong business judgment.

  • Advanced Excel skills and proficiency in Google Workspace; experience with production accounting software is an advantage.

  • Working knowledge of Tally or similar accounting systems is preferred.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple teams.

  • Exceptional attention to detail while maintaining the ability to see the bigger picture.

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related discipline. CA or equivalent professional qualification is preferred.

Who You Are

  • You thrive in fast-moving environments and enjoy solving new challenges every day.

  • You are proactive, resourceful, and comfortable navigating ambiguity.

  • You build strong relationships and enjoy partnering with diverse teams.

  • You balance analytical thinking with practical decision-making.

  • You have high standards, strong integrity, and a commitment to excellence.

  • You're passionate about entertainment and excited to help bring incredible stories to audiences around the world.

Why Netflix?

At Netflix, you'll have the opportunity to work on some of the most exciting productions in the industry while partnering with exceptionally talented people across creative, production, and business teams.

You'll be trusted with meaningful responsibility from day one, encouraged to challenge conventional thinking, and empowered to make an impact on how world-class stories are produced.

If you're excited by the idea of combining finance, strategy, and storytelling, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a Head of Character Effects (CFX) to support our upcoming animated feature film. The Head of Character Effects works inside of NAS as the show-based leader for all character-related secondary motion, including hair, fur, feathers, cloth, and garments. They will partner closely with the Director, Production Designer, VFX Supervisor, Art Director, Head of Characters, Head of Character Animation and Technical Supervisor to ensure that character effects are both artistically compelling and technically robust.

The Head of Character Effects will oversee the CFX team during asset development, look development, and shot production. They will define the simulation approach for the show, review and give notes on all CFX work, and ensure it meets the highest quality bar while remaining efficient and stable in production. This may involve developing or supervising prototypes, guiding grooming and garment construction for simulation, solving complex technical problems, and helping to set up the CFX side of the project for success.

This position is essential in bridging the gap between creative intent and simulation-driven workflows, ensuring that character motion feels alive, expressive, and fully aligned with the film’s visual language. The Head of Character Effects builds strong relationships with creative leadership and with technical and production partners, demonstrating great diplomatic and interpersonal skills to balance artistic ambition with schedule and pipeline constraints.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and supervise Character Effects across the show, from look development to final shot delivery

  • Define the creative and technical approach for hair, fur, cloth, feathers, and other character-related simulations

  • Review CFX assets and shots, providing clear, actionable artistic and technical notes

  • Collaborate with Directors, Production Designers, Art Directors, Head of Characters, Animation, FX, and Look Development to ensure CFX supports character performance and story

Our team exists to bring the fleet along with it: setting clear baselines, accelerating adoption across thousands of services, and protecting that progress from erosion over time. We affect both engineering culture and engineering quality at scale.

We are looking for an experienced L5 Software Engineer who thrives at the intersection of large-scale systems, automation, and cross-functional influence. You will design and build the tooling and automation that powers fleet-wide migration campaigns, partner directly with platform and product teams to de-risk complex infrastructure changes, and help define what excellent Paved Path adoption looks like in practice at Netflix.

This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role. You will own migration projects end-to-end — from scoping and technical design through automated execution, quality validation, and completion. You'll also build durable tooling that outlasts any single campaign.

Key Responsibilities

Migration Engineering
Design and execute large-scale code and infrastructure migration campaigns across Netflix's fleet of thousands of repositories and services. Own the full lifecycle: scoping, campaign design, automated execution, validation, and completion.

Automation & Tooling
Build and extend PME's internal automation platforms — leveraging AI-assisted code modification, rule-based transformations, and batch orchestration — to scale the team's impact across the fleet with speed and reliability.

Technical Design
Write clear, well-researched design documents. Identify and communicate tradeoffs between migration approaches and drive decisions with data and stakeholder input.

Cross-Functional Partnership
Embed with partner teams driving the most crucial infrastructure-level strategic initiatives to deeply understand migration needs, de-risk project execution, and ensure campaigns land successfully with minimal customer toil.

Paved Path Advocacy
Proactively identify opportunities to improve Paved Path adoption and adherence. Surface patterns and systemic opportunities — then act on them. Influence product strategy and roadmaps of platform teams through direct engagement and data.

Operational Excellence
Instrument migrations with telemetry and dashboards. Monitor fleet health, track adoption rates, and build the feedback loops that continuously improve campaign design and execution.

Who You Are

A strong generalist engineer energized by scope and ambiguity — comfortable working across the full stack (backend services, automation pipelines, data models, dashboards) while building depth in the areas that matter most.

A systems thinker who understands that successful migrations are as much about people and process as they are about code — and designs solutions accordingly.

A self-directed owner who can take a high-priority, ambiguous challenge and drive it to completion across teams, time zones, and organizational boundaries.

Someone who builds customer trust through repeated, low-drama delivery. You communicate proactively, course-correct quickly, and leave things better than you found them.

A pragmatic builder who defaults to automation and reuse, builds tools that generalize beyond a single use case, and knows when to ship fast vs. when to invest in durability.

Job Summary:

We’re looking for a Junior Post Engineer to join our Post Engineering team in Vancouver. This role is ideal for someone with hands‑on experience in post, AV, or VFX environments who wants to deepen their technical engineering skills in a high‑end animation studio.

You’ll be a front‑line post engineering resource for our editorial suites, story and review rooms, and our screening theatre. You’ll help ensure our specialty spaces are robust, predictable, and technically sound - from day‑to‑day operations and Tier 1 support through to screenings, production reviews, and special events.

This role includes a strong focus on:

  • Troubleshooting complex specialty spaces (review rooms, theater, multi‑screen/multi‑channel environments)

  • Operating and supporting Q‑SYS–based room control and DSP

  • Understanding and maintaining SDR and HDR colour pipelines for review and screenings

This role requires occasional evening and weekend work, particularly around screenings, special events, and critical production milestones.

What You’ll Do:

Editorial, Review & Theater Support (Tier 1)

Provide Tier 1 troubleshooting and operational support for:

  • Editorial suites (Avid Media Composer)

  • Story and Review Rooms

  • Theater and other specialty screening spaces

  • Audio suites (Avid Pro Tools)

Diagnose and resolve first‑line issues related to:

  • Avid Media Composer and Avid Pro Tools

  • Autodesk RV and other VFX/animation review tools

  • Q‑SYS–controlled systems (routing, presets, room states, monitoring)

  • Playback systems, operator workstations, and peripherals

Perform basic verification of audio/video signal flow and KVM paths; identify when to escalate to more senior engineers.

Clearly document issues and escalate complex problems to the Post Engineering team and cross functionals with relevant details, logs, and reproducible steps.

Screenings, Reviews & Events

  • Set up, operate, and tear down for:

    • Internal screenings and dailies

    • Production reviews in our theater and review rooms

    • External screenings, previews, and Q&A sessions

  • Operate and support:

    • Xenon-based digital cinema projectors

    • Q‑SYS (or similar) audio/room automation systems

    • Playback, presentation, and basic routing of audio and video content

  • Ensure correct colour space, dynamic range, and format are used for each screening (e.g., SDR vs HDR, Rec.709 vs P3), flagging inconsistencies or mismatches.

  • Partner with Production, Editorial, Facilities, and vendors to ensure events start on time and run smoothly.

Media Systems & Workflows

  • Support day‑to‑day operation of media and review systems used in animation and VFX pipelines, including:

    • Avid editorial workflows

    • Autodesk RV and other review tools

  • Assist Post Engineering team with:

    • Routine checks and basic maintenance of theaters, review rooms, and editorial systems

    • Verifying and troubleshooting audio/video signal flow and KVM paths where required

Operations, Documentation & Collaboration

  • Perform regular room and system health checks; log issues, resolutions, and follow‑ups

  • Contribute to and maintain documentation of room configurations, standard operating procedures, and common troubleshooting steps (e.g., within Jira, Confluence, or similar tools)

  • Work closely within Post Engineering, Technology, and Production teams to ensure stable, predictable, and artist‑friendly environments.

  • Provide calm, professional support in live, time‑sensitive scenarios such as screenings and reviews.

  • Participate in off‑hours maintenance and event coverage on a rotational or as‑needed basis.

What You’ll Need:

Experience & Background

  • 2-3 years of experience in a similar role within AV, Post Production, Broadcast, or VFX/Animation environments.

  • Hands-on experience supporting theaters, screening rooms, edit suites, or review spaces.

  • Strong familiarity with animation or VFX post-production workflows (editorial, reviews, dailies, deliveries).

Core Technical Skills

  • Working knowledge of:

    • Xenon digital cinema projectors (operation, calibration  and basic troubleshooting)

    • Q‑SYS or similar room automation / DSP systems

    • Avid Media Composer and Avid Pro Tools in a shared or networked environment

    • Autodesk RV and related VFX/animation playback tools

  • Solid understanding of:

    • Audio and video signal flow (routing, patching, monitoring)

    • Basic networking concepts (IP addressing, connectivity, basic diagnostics)

    • Multiple operating systems, with emphasis on Rocky Linux; exposure to macOS/Windows is a plus

  • Comfort with other VFX/post software and willingness to learn new tools as needed.

Soft Skills

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot OS and application issues at a Tier 1 level.

  • Strong customer service mindset and clear, concise communication with non‑technical users.

  • Detail‑oriented with the ability to follow and improve documentation and standard procedures.

  • Ability to stay composed and effective in live events and high‑pressure situations.

  • Willingness to work evenings and weekends as production and event schedules require.

  • Collaborative, curious, and eager to grow into more advanced post engineering responsibilities.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in colour workflows and colour management, including:

    • Working with calibrated displays and digital cinema projectors

    • Understanding of colour spaces and transforms (e.g., SDR/HDR workflows, PQ, HLG, Rec.709, P3)

    • Performing or assisting with calibration of projectors and reference displays

  • Experience working in HDR environments (review, QC, or finishing).

  • Exposure to digital cinema standards (e.g., DCP), and SDR/HDR review workflows.

  • Familiarity with video routing and KVM systems.

  • Previous experience in a feature animation or high‑end episodic VFX studio.

This role is unique in its scope: you will support the launch and growth of multiple markets. The ideal candidate is proficient in programmatic advertising, has strong experience working with DSPs (Demand-Side Platforms), and can manage complexity across markets with varying maturity levels.

Cultural agility is a core requirement. You will engage with partners and clients across diverse European markets, each with distinct business cultures, communication styles, and expectations. The ability to build trust and credibility across these markets — and to adapt fluidly — is as critical as your technical expertise.

The Security Services Engineering organization supports the Netflix workforce by creating and operating the security access control model, including authentication, authorization, and cryptographic software services. Our access control use cases will continue to become more complex as we increase investment in Netflix Originals content production ecosystems, including Content, GenAI, Ads, Gaming, Live streaming, and more. Our workforce and partners are global, and they access our information in different patterns and with varying needs from various locations and devices. With security and ease of information access in mind for our ongoing growth, we recognize that the traditional corporate network security perimeter no longer meets our requirements. Instead, we invest in identity as a perimeter on the open internet, with reliable, robust, and strong access-control models and services to protect our information.

The Role

This role focuses on building the access experience layer at Netflix — designing, building, and operating the services that make access control safe and straightforward for hundreds of internal engineering teams. You will be part of the Access Experience Engineering (AXE) team in Warsaw, Poland, focusing on the integration and experience layer that sits on top of Netflix's core access control infrastructure. You will partner closely with ACE and the Security Services Engineering organization, both primarily based in UCAN, as part of a follow-the-sun, async-first model.

You will work on a mix of projects encompassing ownership of system design, implementation, partner integration, rollout strategy, and maintenance of access tooling and integration services — including the adoption layer for future of access management at Netflix, Netflix's next-generation access management platform, as well as APIs, SDKs, and self-service workflows that enable internal teams to implement access securely and consistently.

One engineer on this team will serve as an in-time-zone security anchor — a technical lead who brings a pragmatic, risk-aware lens to AXE's designs and implementations and partners directly with ACE Core on security architecture decisions.

This role is based in Poland and can be performed remotely within the country.

  • Ability to work collaboratively to solve problems, navigate ambiguity, make and communicate self-directed decisions, and weigh trade-offs. You take ownership of problems and are able to influence others.

  • Proficiency in modern languages (Java preferred, or Kotlin, Go, Python) and an openness to work across the tech stack as needed.

  • Experience designing and building developer-facing APIs, SDKs, and integration patterns that make complex systems straightforward for other teams to adopt.

  • Familiarity with access control and IAM concepts — identity, authentication, authorization, roles, groups, attributes, and resource models. Experience with auth protocols, including OpenID Connect, OAuth, SAML, and SCIM, is valuable; strong software engineering fundamentals with an interest in the domain are equally welcome.

  • Experience with GraphQL, gRPC, REST, or similar technologies.

  • Effective written communication skills and a product-focused mindset, with a security-first approach, enabling you to deliver practical solutions while working across EMEA and UCAN time zones in an async-first environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing complex access control models using industry standards like RBAC, ABAC, or ReBAC.

 The Opportunity: 

As an Associate Technical Supervisor at Netflix Animation Studios, you’ll help support the technical vision on an animated feature film by working in close partnership with the Technical Supervisor, Solutions Engineering and creative leadership. You’ll contribute to shaping and evolving the pipeline tools, and workflows to meet the show’s unique creative and technical challenges, ensuring solutions that serve both the artists and align with studio standards. 

This role focuses on the technical success across the production pipeline and may be scoped towards supporting the Front End, Performance, or Back End, depending on show needs and your experience. Your primary focus will be supporting the creative and visual objectives by providing day-to-day technical oversight for pipeline troubleshooting, user support, direction, and tool development.

You will oversee technical direction and support for one or more stages of the production pipeline, such as:

Front End:

  • Story

  • Edit

  • Art / Concept / Design / Visual Development

  • Previs

  • Modeling

  • Rigging

  • Surfacing of Characters and Environments

  • Procedural Assets (if not covered by another Associate Tech Supervisor)

Performance:

  • Animation

  • Edit

  • Rough Layout

  • Final Layout

  • Previs (if not covered by another Associate Tech Supervisor)

Back End:

  • Lighting

  • Rendering

  • Compositing

  • Imaging

  • Final Output / Delivery

  • Simulation / FX (if not covered by another Associate Tech Supervisor)

Across these areas, you will ensure that all technical processes, tools, and workflows are running smoothly, meet the show’s creative and technical requirements, and integrate well with the rest of the pipeline. You will provide hands-on technical leadership to TDs, support artists with technical challenges, and collaborate with the Technical Supervisor and other Associate Technical Supervisors to maintain consistency and quality across the entire production.

What You’ll Do:


Technical Responsibilities

  • Understand the film’s visual goals and design tools, workflows, and procedures that enable artists to achieve them.

  • Troubleshoot and optimize production workflows, providing practical solutions to visual and technical problems through existing tools or new tool development.

  • Safeguard artist productivity by testing and validating new tools and pipeline changes, tracking and resolving issues in partnership with Technical Supervisors, Solutions Engineering, and R&D.

  • Contribute to building and improving the show and studio-wide pipeline, ensuring efficient collaboration across departments and supporting broader technical objectives.

Bidding & Scheduling: 

  • Track and manage development initiatives for the show, monitoring estimates, scope, and deadlines, and adjusting plans as needed to keep work on track.

  • Partner with the Technical Supervisor to prioritize and resolve top support issues, coordinating cross‑departmental testing to move high‑priority fixes through the pipeline quickly.

  • Organize technical work by breaking down projects into manageable parts, aligning fortnightly support allocation, and clearly communicating production and technical information to TDs and Program Managers.

  • Collaborate with the Technical Supervisor and Solutions Engineering Manager to prepare estimates, pitches, and plans for show-specific technical work.

Talent & Performance Management:

  • Provide day-to-day technical guidance to TDs, collaborating with the Solutions Engineering Manager to escalate issues through the right channels when needed.

  • Mentor and develop TDs, supporting onboarding for new team members and partnering with Technology Talent Management and Solutions Engineering Managers to grow skills across the department.

  • Identify team management issues early and work with Tech Talent Management to put constructive solutions in place.

  • Foster collaboration and create synergies between different work groups to drive efficiency, optimization, and innovative ways of working.

Communication, Collaboration & Relationship Development:

  • Communicate clearly and concisely on technical topics, including project status, requirements, problems, and rollout plans, both verbally and in writing.

  • Collaborate with Program Managers on scheduling and planning show-based initiatives, providing accurate status and expectations.

  • Tailor communication to your audience: explain issues in accessible, non-technical language to artists and production, and discuss complex topics in depth with developers and supervisors.

  • Confidently present to small teams (e.g., tool demos, pipeline processes, support dashboards) and produce clear written documentation such as specs, tickets, and status updates.

What You’ll Need:

  • 5+ years of proven pipeline TD experience in animated features, animated TV series, and/or VFX feature films, with demonstrated leadership in feature animation or VFX.

  • Strong technical foundation, including solid Python skills (plus PyQt or another GUI toolkit), familiarity with data flow/metadata/publishing concepts, and the ability to review code and troubleshoot issues; basic C++ and USD knowledge are a plus.

  • Deep understanding of traditional production workflows, tools, and techniques, with experience using and troubleshooting relevant DCCs and production tracking software such as Flow Production Tracking (ShotGrid) or similar.

  • Experience with modern software development and collaboration practices, including git/GitHub, code review processes, and Agile methodologies using tools such as Jira.

  • Demonstrated strength in problem-solving, conflict resolution, and risk awareness, with the ability to adapt to evolving project requirements and dynamic team interactions.

  • Degree in Animation, Film, Computer Science, Design, Engineering, Math, or Physics, or equivalent professional experience in animation/VFX.

Job Summary:

The Procedural Asset and FX Technical Director is a Houdini TD responsible for supporting all teams that use Sidefx Houdini. They work with the front-end assets team, such as Surfacing and Modelling, and also back end shot-based teams: Fx, Character-fx, Crowds, and Matte Painting.

They assist creative and visual objectives through pipeline troubleshooting, user support, technical direction, and tool development. The TD will participate in the development of artist workflows and tools for projects and debug problematic workflow steps to support global studio productions in that area. The TD will work closely with their craft groups and show leadership, the Solutions Engineering and R&D teams to enable high-quality technical outcomes and a standardized approach.

What You’ll Do:

  • Provide technical expertise and guidance for Houdini and USD technology for the departments they support.

  • Understand the visual requirements for productions and propose new technologies, or design procedures, techniques, and tools to ensure those needs are met.

  • Provide technical expertise and guidance for technology within the PAFX department.

  • Participate in or lead the direction, evolution & maintenance of technology within the PAFX department.

  • Design, develop, review and write well-maintainable, production level and consistently high-quality code.

  • Track, debug, and resolve workflow issues in partnership with technical supervisors, associate technical supervisors, solutions engineers, and R&D.

  • Work closely with other TD’s on the team to drive the technical success of key development initiatives.

  • Communicate clearly, via instant messaging systems like Slack, to proactively report on issues that may affect others, provide updates on software releases, and offer assistance to other team members.

  • Ensure that technology, tools, and procedures support the creative process.

  • Provide solutions to visual problems through existing tools or by leading the implementation of new tools.

  • Take responsibility for the troubleshooting & optimization of the tools, software, and workflows of the PAFX department.

  • Actively participate in or drive QA, technical testing, and validation of new technology, tool releases, or pipeline changes such that artist workflow is not impacted.

  • Understand the processes of adjoining departments and provide input where required to maximize pipeline efficiency and quality.

  • Actively participate in brainstorming and problem-solving, contributing technical expertise and insight, to create and maintain technology within the canonical production pipeline.

  • Support the organization's overall technical goals as required.

  • Demonstrate excellent communication skills, including the ability to clearly present work to stakeholders, actively gather feedback, and incorporate it into technical solutions.

  • Be aware of the deadlines for development initiatives and actively engage in keeping these on track.

  • Continuously monitor the scope of development initiatives and help to ensure scope adjustments have additional estimates, etc.

  • Prioritize and break down technical projects into organized parts and describe them in Jira

  • Provide technical guidance to other TDs and TAs, where appropriate, with day-to-day issues and escalation through the right channels when necessary.

  • Mentor junior team members and assist in orientation with new starters.

  • Create synergies between different work groups to promote efficiency and optimization and to generate innovative ideas and approaches to how we do things

What You’ll Need:

Experience:

  • 5+ years of proven pipeline TD experience in large-scale animated features, animated TV series, the gaming industry, and/or VFX feature films.

  • Solid production/industry experience as a TD, ideally as part of a team.

Skills/Knowledge:

  • Comprehensive Houdini experience with using and troubleshooting procedural node-based workflows.

  • A strong understanding of USD and its general concepts, including Houdini’s Solaris/LOP context.

  • Proven ability to design and build production-ready Houdini Digital Assets (HDAs) to simplify artist workflows and abstract complex operations.

  • An understanding of traditional techniques appropriate to Assets (Surfacing, hair and feather grooming, lookdev, procedural vegetation, or environment modelling)

  • Good knowledge of shot-based simulation craft groups such as FX, Character-FX, Crowd and Matte-Painting and appropriate techniques they may use.

  • Expertise in configuring and customizing the Houdini environment for production use.

  • Practical experience in developing custom user interfaces using Python (PySide/PyQt).

  • Knowledge of version control software such as git, as well as the ability to code review and troubleshoot problems as they arise in GitHub.

  • Knowledge in Python as well as PyQt or another GUI toolkit.

  • Knowledge of concepts like data flow, data dependencies, metadata, publishing, and retrieval.

  • Knowledge of Flow Production Tracking (Shotgrid).

  • Knowledge of software development practices such as Agile and how to apply them in software such as Jira.

  • Degree in Animation, Film, Computer Science, Design, Engineering, Math or Physics, or equivalent combination of education & work experience in animation/VFX.

  • Knowledge of other DCCs such as Maya, Nuke and/or similar software in the animation domain is a plus.

  • A basic understanding of C++ is a plus.

This role is based in Vancouver, British Columbia. Hybrid Role (Minimum requirement of 3 days a week in the office).

We are looking for a Manager for the Ads Finance & Strategy team, based in Germany to act as the strategic partner to the Ads Sales business. This role partners with the Ads Sales country lead and broader leadership to define the long term ads strategy for the DACH markets, translate it into actionable annual and multi‑year plans, and advise local Ads leadership on market positioning, strategic initiatives, and growth priorities.
 

Key Responsibilities

  • Build a comprehensive, forward‑looking view of the German, Austrian and Swiss advertising markets— trends, regulations, competitive landscape, agency and advertiser dynamics — and identify long‑term growth opportunities across verticals, segments, formats and partner ecosystems.

  • Partner with FP&A and the wider Finance & Strategy  team to lead a long‑term annual planning process for the DACH markets, covering market sizing, targets, investment cases and pricing/deal strategy aligned to long‑term revenue goals.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a Character Modeling Supervisor to support our upcoming feature film. The Character Modeling Supervisor works inside of NAS to lead the character modeling team on a specific film or series, focusing on the creation of high‑quality character assets that faithfully translate the show’s designs into 3D. This role helps ensure that all character models are both artistically compelling and technically ready for Rigging, Surfacing, CFX, and Animation, working within the direction and standards set by the Head of Characters and show leadership.

What You’ll Do

  • Supervise the creation of character models (hero, secondary, background) that align with the Director’s and Art Director’s vision and the show’s visual style

  • Work closely with the Art Director (Characters), Character Designers, and Head of Characters to interpret design intent and maintain consistency of proportion, style, and appeal

  • Lead character modeling reviews and provide clear, specific, and constructive feedback on form, anatomy, silhouette, topology, and overall quality

  • Ensure character models meet technical requirements and pipeline standards so they integrate smoothly with Rigging, Surfacing, CFX, and Animation

  • Collaborate with Technical Supervisors, TDs, and Production Technology to support and refine modeling tools, workflows, and asset management processes

  • Provide input to Production Management and department leadership on asset complexity and progress to support realistic planning and prioritization

  • Partner with Rigging, Surfacing, CFX, Environments, and Animation to resolve design or technical issues and maintain alignment across departments

  • Mentor and support character modelers, helping to identify training needs and contributing to performance feedback and skill development

  • Help foster a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative team culture where artists can do their best work

What You’ll Need

  • Significant experience as a Character Modeler in feature animation, VFX, or high‑end series, including time in a Lead or Supervisory role

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating excellence in character modeling (stylized and/or realistic), with clear understanding of anatomy, form, and appeal

  • Proficiency in modeling and sculpting tools such as Maya and ZBrush (additional tools a plus)

  • Strong understanding of how character models interact with Rigging, Surfacing, CFX, and Animation within a production pipeline

  • Great communication and leadership skills, with the ability to give clear, constructive feedback and collaborate effectively across departments

  • Strong organizational and time‑management skills

This role is based out of Sydney, Australia. Hybrid Role (Minimum of 3 days a week in the office).

Job Summary:

The Head of Environments works inside of NAS as the show-based leader for all digital environments, sets, and props. They will partner closely with the Director, Production Designer, VFX Supervisor, Art Director (Environments), Head of Assets, and Technical Supervisor to ensure that environmental designs are both artistically compelling and technically robust.

The Head of Environments will oversee the environment asset teams—including Modeling, Surfacing, and Matte Painting—during asset development, look development, and shot production. They will define the technical and artistic approach for environment construction, review and give notes on all set and prop builds, and ensure they meet the highest quality bar while remaining efficient and stable in production. This involves translating 2D concepts into 3D space, guiding camera projections and matte painting integration, solving complex technical pipeline challenges, and helping set up the environmental asset build of the project for success.

This position is essential in bridging the gap between artistic vision and 3D technical reality, ensuring that digital environments feel immersive, stylized, and fully aligned with the film’s visual language. The Head of Environments builds strong relationships with creative leadership and technical/production partners, demonstrating great leadership and communication skills to balance artistic ambition with schedule, budget, and pipeline constraints.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and supervise environment asset creation across the show, providing creative and technical guidance for digital environments, sets, and props.

  • Define the creative and technical approach for modeling, surfacing, camera projections, and matte painting elements in line with the Director's vision.

  • Drive team reviews and provide detailed, actionable creative and technical feedback to Modeling, Surfacing, and DMP departments.

  • Collaborate with Directors, Production Designers, Art Directors, and VFX Supervisors to effectively translate 2D environment designs into 3D production-ready sets.

  • Partner with Technical Supervisors, Production Technology, and pipeline teams to define, optimize, and maintain efficient asset-creation tools and standardized canonical workflows.

  • Ensure all environment assets adhere to high technical standards and integrate seamlessly into downstream departments such as Layout, Lighting, and Compositing.

  • Work closely with Production Management on bids, schedules, and resource priorities to deliver high-quality environments on time and within budget.

  • Mentor and support Modeling, Surfacing, and DMP Supervisors and artists, fostering professional growth, skill development, and a positive team culture.

  • Communicate effectively across disciplines, translating complex technical concepts into accessible language for creative partners and vice versa.

  • Collaborate with grace, humility, inclusion, and open-mindedness.

What You’ll Need

  • At least 10 years of experience in environment asset creation within film, TV, or games, including 5–7 years in a leadership or supervisory role on large-scale animated features or VFX films.

  • Expert knowledge of Modeling and Surfacing workflows, with a deep understanding of 3D environment layout, asset builds, volume, form, and camera projections.

  • Proven production-level proficiency in Maya and ZBrush/Mudbox, texturing packages (Substance, Mari, Photoshop), and matte painting/projection workflows.

  • Expert understanding of digital film pipelines and related technologies, including Katana, RenderMan, and real-time pipelines.

  • Strong 2D skills to quickly mock up and iterate concepts, helping define the visual and spatial rules of the environments.

  • Experience with project management and production tracking systems such as Flow Production Tracking (ShotGrid).

  • Excellent leadership, communication, and mentoring skills, with the ability to foster collaboration across diverse departments and personalities.

  • Highly motivated self-starter with excellent time management, organizational skills, and the ability to make considered judgments under production pressure.

This role is based in Vancouver, British Columbia. Hybrid Role (Minimum of 3 days a week in the office).

The charter is to build internal tooling, developer-facing UIs, and shared services that reduce duplication and let CIE's domain teams to increase velocity. ROLE

Netflix is redefining interactive and cinematic entertainment. The N‑Tech Manager, Technology Systems and Operations (Creative Tech), based in Vancouver, plays a pivotal role in enabling seamless, secure, and scalable technology experiences for our Games and VFX production teams globally.

This leader drives innovation in creative technology support, automates workflows, and elevates operational excellence to empower Netflix’s Games and VFX studios. You will be responsible for the operation, integration, and continuous evolution of technology services that support Netflix’s creative production teams. You will refine technical support models, drive automation, and enhance services that underpin Games and VFX production. You’ll also manage internal teams and managed service providers (MSPs) to deliver high‑quality support while fostering innovation and efficiency.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Strategic Leadership & Technology Vision

    • Act as a key strategic partner to Games and VFX studio leadership and cross-functional business units, aligning technology support roadmaps with long-term studio goals to drive innovation, efficiency, and seamless integration of Games and VFX production workflows.

    • Define and execute a technology operations strategy that enhances Games and VFX production efficiency, leveraging automation and technology-first proactive support models to align with Netflix’s Games and VFX studio growth and the N‑Tech Learning Engine framework.

    • Build and develop a high-performing team, fostering an environment of growth, technical excellence, and innovation while leading the evolution of technical support services, ensuring scalability, security, and operational excellence.

    • Champion user-centric, efficient technology experiences across all Games and VFX studio operations.
       

  • Operational Management & Service Excellence

    • Oversee daily operations of the Technology Systems and Operations Specialist (TSOS) team, ensuring optimal coverage and performance at all times.

    • Proactively remove roadblocks for the team by optimizing support workflows, automating troubleshooting, and leveraging real-time analytics to enhance the technology support experience.

    • Implement best practices for technical support, issue resolution, and incident management, ensuring rapid response and minimal disruption to Games and VFX studios.

    • Establish and refine operational procedures, leveraging data-driven insights to optimize efficiency and scalability while ensuring optimal resource utilization.
       

  • Collaboration & Technical Integration

    • Act as a strategic partner to Games and VFX studios, engineering teams, enterprise operations, and strategic sourcing teams, aligning technology roadmaps with business objectives.

    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve supportability and proactively address recurring technology challenges across Games and VFX production pipelines.

    • Ensure seamless integration of Netflix-owned and third-party Games and VFX tools, including emerging GenAI/GenMedia solutions, supporting efficiency, innovation, and secure, scalable creative workflows

    • Partner with engineering and product teams to gather feedback and provide insights, driving continuous improvement.

    • Drive alignment across teams by standardizing support processes and ensuring consistency in operational execution.

    • Develop root cause analysis reports, identify trends, and implement proactive solutions with the Workforce Productivity teams to mitigate recurring issues.

    • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex technical issues, ensuring timely resolution through collaboration with engineering, platform, and infrastructure teams.

    • Develop and conduct training programs for internal teams and external partners, promoting best practices and technological literacy.
       

NECESSARY SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • 10+ years’ experience managing technical operations or technology support in Games, VFX, animation, or similar production environments, with at least 5 years in a leadership or managerial role.

  • Deep understanding of Games and/or VFX pipelines, real-time rendering, and DCC and engine tools (e.g., Maya, Nuke, Unreal Engine, Unity)

  • Strong understanding of studio network architecture, high-performance storage solutions, and cloud-based Games and/or VFX production environments.

  • Hands-on experience with Games/VFX tools, pipelines, automation, and other related systems.

  • Proficiency with remote and virtualized workstation technologies (Teradici, Parsec, Citrix, VDI).

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership and problem-solving skills, with the ability to bridge gaps between creative and technical teams.

  • Ability to work independently and drive alignment amid ambiguity with minimal supervision.

  • Ability to translate complex technical challenges into actionable strategies for executives, developers, and creative teams.

  • Experience making informed, agile decisions and executing them quickly at the global/regional level.

  • Expertise in utilizing metrics and data to analyze and assess business priorities, drive decision-making, set strategy, and measure success in achieving organizational goals.

  • Proficiency with JIRA, Confluence, Tableau, Zendesk, and other ITSM tools.

  • Experience working with distributed and remote teams in a global Games/VFX production environment.

  • Ability to represent the greater organization’s mission and vision to teams and stakeholders.

  • Passion for games, VFX, animation, and entertainment technology.

  • Flexibility in working hours to meet the needs of the business.

The Opportunity:

As an Associate Technical Supervisor at Netflix Animation Studios, you’ll help support the technical vision on an animated feature film by working in close partnership with the Technical Supervisor, Solutions Engineering and creative leadership. You’ll contribute to shaping and evolving the pipeline tools, and workflows to meet the show’s unique creative and technical challenges, ensuring solutions that serve both the artists and align with studio standards. 

Focused on the technical success of Fx, Lighting and Compositing on the show, your primary focus will be supporting the creative and visual objectives by providing day-to-day technical oversight for pipeline troubleshooting, user support, direction and tool development.

The Associate Technical Supervisor (Back End) oversees the technical direction and support for the later stages of the production pipeline.  This includes departments and workflows such as:

  • Lighting

  • Rendering

  • Compositing

  • Imaging

  • Final Output/Delivery

  • Simulation/FX (if not covered by another Associate Tech Sup)

  • Pipeline integration and troubleshooting for these stages

The Back End Associate Tech Sup ensures that all technical processes, tools, and workflows in these areas are running smoothly, meet the show’s creative and technical requirements, and integrate well with the rest of the pipeline. They also provide hands-on technical leadership to TDs in these departments, support artists with technical challenges, and collaborate with the Technical Supervisor and other Associate Tech Sups to maintain consistency and quality across the entire production.


 

What You’ll Do:


Technical Responsibilities

  • Understand the film’s visual goals and design tools, workflows, and procedures that enable artists to achieve them.

  • Troubleshoot and optimize production workflows, providing practical solutions to visual and technical problems through existing tools or new tool development.

  • Safeguard artist productivity by testing and validating new tools and pipeline changes, tracking and resolving issues in partnership with Technical Supervisors, Solutions Engineering, and R&D.

  • Contribute to building and improving the show and studio-wide pipeline, ensuring efficient collaboration across departments and supporting broader technical objectives.

Bidding & Scheduling: 

  • Track and manage development initiatives for the show, monitoring estimates, scope, and deadlines, and adjusting plans as needed to keep work on track.

  • Partner with the Technical Supervisor to prioritize and resolve top support issues, coordinating cross‑departmental testing to move high‑priority fixes through the pipeline quickly.

  • Organize technical work by breaking down projects into manageable parts, aligning fortnightly support allocation, and clearly communicating production and technical information to TDs and Program Managers.

  • Collaborate with the Technical Supervisor and Solutions Engineering Manager to prepare estimates, pitches, and plans for show-specific technical work.

Talent & Performance Management:

  • Provide day-to-day technical guidance to TDs, collaborating with the Solutions Engineering Manager to escalate issues through the right channels when needed.

  • Mentor and develop TDs, supporting onboarding for new team members and partnering with Technology Talent Management and Solutions Engineering Managers to grow skills across the department.

  • Identify team management issues early and work with Tech Talent Management to put constructive solutions in place.

  • Foster collaboration and create synergies between different work groups to drive efficiency, optimization, and innovative ways of working.


 

Communication, Collaboration & Relationship Development

  • Communicate clearly and concisely on technical topics, including project status, requirements, problems, and rollout plans, both verbally and in writing.

  • Collaborate with Program Managers on scheduling and planning show-based initiatives, providing accurate status and expectations.

  • Tailor communication to your audience: explain issues in accessible, non-technical language to artists and production, and discuss complex topics in depth with developers and supervisors.

  • Confidently present to small teams (e.g., tool demos, pipeline processes, support dashboards) and produce clear written documentation such as specs, tickets, and status updates.

What You’ll Need:

  • 5+ years of proven pipeline TD experience in animated features, animated TV series, and/or VFX feature films, with demonstrated leadership in feature animation or VFX.

  • Strong technical foundation, including solid Python skills (plus PyQt or another GUI toolkit), familiarity with data flow/metadata/publishing concepts, and the ability to review code and troubleshoot issues; basic C++ and USD knowledge are a plus.

  • Deep understanding of traditional production workflows, tools, and techniques, with experience using and troubleshooting relevant DCCs and production tracking software such as Flow Production Tracking (ShotGrid) or similar.

  • Experience with modern software development and collaboration practices, including git/GitHub, code review processes, and Agile methodologies using tools such as Jira.

  • Demonstrated strength in problem-solving, conflict resolution, and risk awareness, with the ability to adapt to evolving project requirements and dynamic team interactions.

  • Degree in Animation, Film, Computer Science, Design, Engineering, Math, or Physics, or equivalent professional experience in animation/VFX.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a Head of Effects to support our upcoming animated feature film. The Head of Effects works inside of NAS as the show-based leader for all Effects work on the production, including water, fire, smoke, atmospherics, destruction, debris, and magical or abstract effects. They will partner closely with the Director, Production Designer, Art Directors, and other department heads to define the look, behavior, and storytelling role of Effects on the show.

The Head of Effects will oversee Effects look development, tool and workflow design, and shot production. They will review and give notes on Effects assets and shots to ensure the work is of the highest quality, integrates seamlessly with environments, characters, lighting, and compositing, and fulfills the Director’s vision. This may involve developing prototypes, helping define Effects approaches for complex sequences, writing or guiding the creation of tools, and setting up the Effects side of the project for success.

This position is essential in bridging creative intent and technical execution, ensuring that Effects enhances the emotional and visual impact of the film. The Head of Effects will work closely with production, technical, and creative partners, demonstrating strong diplomatic and interpersonal skills to balance artistic ambition with schedule, budget, and pipeline constraints.
 

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and supervise Effects across the show, from look development through to final shot delivery

  • Define the creative and technical approach for key Effects (water, fire, smoke, atmospherics, destruction, magical/abstract) in collaboration with Directors and Art Directors

  • Review Effects work, providing clear, actionable notes to artists and TAs on both artistic quality and technical reliability

  • Collaborate with Layout, Animation, CFX, Environments, Lighting, and Compositing to ensure Effects supports performance, readability, and story

  • Partner with Technical Supervisors, Production Technology, and R&D to develop and maintain robust, efficient Effects tools and workflows

Our Legal team in Tokyo is looking for a new member to join the team: a Manager, Music Business Affairs who shares our passion for music, the entertainment industry and great content. Someone who seeks out and thrives in an environment where freedom and responsibility are a tenet, and passion, innovation and curiosity are mandates.  A stunning and selfless colleague for whom no task is too small or insurmountable.  If you loved the series and the music in Glass Heart and Stranger Things or if you love anime, this could be the job for you…

This unique and exciting role will  focus on providing music business, legal and strategy support for the production of Netflix Originals. The role will have broad responsibility and unique insight into multiple aspects of our business and the opportunity to work with a wide number of internal and external partners. This role would also work closely with Netflix's Music Team who are responsible for all of Netflix’s global music business and legal affairs and music strategy, from the production and licensing of Netflix Originals through to the distribution of the Netflix service globally. In addition to being supported by the Legal team based in the Tokyo office, this role will also be supported by the Music Group and its members across the globe.  This role will be based in our Tokyo office and will be a part of the Japan Legal team, while functionally reporting into the global Music team.

RESPONSIBILITIES
Responsibilities include overseeing all music business & legal affairs and all music clearance and music licensing matters during production (film, series), marketing and PR campaigns.  

This includes supporting our production partners in their negotiation of music deals (eg, composer, artist and songwriter deals, music supervisor deals, music clearances and music licensing deals, worldwide public domain assessments, record company and music publishing waivers) in addition to handling certain music deals in-house (eg, negotiating commercial terms and structuring, negotiating and drafting agreements with composers, songwriters, artists, performers, producers, record companies and music publishers, and clearing music and negotiating music license contracts).

This role will also provide music business & legal support and guidance to internal teams, including negotiating and drafting music terms in production services agreements, content licenses and other rights acquisition deals, providing guidance around the creation and delivery of cue sheets, song credits, providing music guidance and working closely with teams such as the Music Production teams and Creative teams, and leading and presenting music presentations and educational music sessions to internal teams and external production partners.  In addition, this role will also support ancillary exploitations of music rights such as soundtrack albums.   


As a Manager, Music Business Affairs your music experience enables you to handle any music situation or issue that may be encountered on a production. You are not flustered by the last minute surprises that inevitably arise when shooting a live action project, series, film or documentary.  

You are able to calmly navigate those situations to arrive at the best solution for the production and for Netflix.

You understand the dynamics among directors, executive producers, creative, line producers, producers, finance, production, post production, credits, labor, marketing, publicity, content localization, business and legal affairs and know when and how to engage and align the appropriate teams when a music issue arises. You also have a deep understanding of the music industry and the dynamics among recording artists, songwriters, record companies, music publishers, music producers, music supervisors's and CMOs such as JASRAC.  

You are comfortable evaluating risk with imperfect or lack of information and have the confidence to make quick decisions.  You may produce locally but you think globally. 


This is an opportunity to shape the future of entertainment.  

The ideal candidate will have: deep expertise in the music market for the production of series and/or film;  and hands-on experience in music clearance, music licensing and negotiating commercial terms and drafting music agreements for series/film/documentary production.   

REQUIREMENTS

The ideal candidate will have: 5+ years of music production experience for anime, series, film or documentaries, including direct, hands-on experience in structuring, negotiating and drafting composer, performer and featured artist agreements, master use and synchronization license agreements, music supervisor agreements, songwriter agreements, record company and music publishing waivers and soundtrack album agreements; in-depth knowledge of music copyright and the series/film production process - from development, budgeting, pre-production, production and post production to music clearance/licensing to composer engagement/recording through to delivery, cue sheets, marketing  and launch; practical knowledge of the Japan music and entertainment industries, including the role of CMOs such as JASRAC, and active relationships with music agents, lawyers,  managers, music publishers and record companies.  Experience providing in-house support in an anime, television, documentary or film production company and/or network is highly preferred.

  • Resourceful and able to pivot quickly, think practically and be solution-oriented

  • Tech-savvy, with a strong sense of how cloud-based document and database systems are used in a modern business environment

The Team

At Netflix, the mission of our ads business is to build a must-buy advertising solution where clients (marketers and agencies) can reach diverse audiences who are highly engaged with the breadth and quality of our content.  The Ads Marketing team shapes our core advertising positioning and drives the go-to-market strategy to bring this positioning to life through compelling, differentiated messaging and activations.  By activating these messages across both sales channels (presentations, materials) and broader non-sales channels, the team builds widespread awareness and excitement among our key advertising partners. 

The Opportunity 

As the Ads Marketing Manager, Germany, you will play a crucial role in establishing Netflix Ads predominately in the German market, with a light touch in Austria and Switzerland as well. You'll be responsible for strategizing and executing B2B marketing activities that drive brand recognition, align with sales objectives, and resonate with local advertisers. This role requires a proactive, versatile marketer with a firm grasp of the B2B landscape and experience in cross-functional collaboration.

You will also engage in broader business strategies and actively pursue learning and development opportunities, continually growing and evolving as a Netflix marketer and leader.

Core Responsibilities: 

  • Develop Go-to-Market Strategies: Design and craft dynamic go-to-market strategies and narratives that empower the Sales team and resonate with advertising clients. Collaborate closely with the Global Ads Marketing team to ensure alignment with global messaging.

  • Event Strategy & Industry Engagement: Lead Netflix Ads’ presence at local industry events and custom client engagements, ensuring impactful representation and relevance at each touchpoint.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with teams across Communications, Product Marketing, Measurement, Sales, Brand Partnerships, Comms, Events and Marketing to maintain a unified ads narrative across all channels and touchpoints, support market launches and foster ongoing growth in Germany and German speaking markets.

  • Business Goal Alignment: Synthesize business objectives to define key audiences, optimal channels, and regions to activate, ensuring marketing initiatives align with overarching goals.

  • Data & Insights Analysis: Utilize data insights and new ad solutions to uncover and share compelling B2B stories tailored to the region and German market, enriching the value proposition for advertising partners.

  • Advertiser Relationships & Insights: Gain a deep understanding of advertiser partners and gather actionable insights that shape both product and marketing strategies, representing partner needs to cross-functional teams.

  • Point of Contact for Trade Bodies: Serve as the main point of contact for activating and managing relationships with local trade bodies, enhancing industry alignment and fostering credibility.

  • Leadership Updates: Deliver consistent updates to leadership, providing a comprehensive view of successes, challenges, and requests, ensuring transparency and support for the German market’s strategic goals.

  • Proven expertise in product positioning, narrative crafting, and collateral development.

About the Team

The Testing Tools & Infrastructure team within the Consumer Lifecycle Experiences Platform is crucial to our Commerce organization. It serves Commerce Experiences by making pre-production testing faster and more reliable. It achieves this by providing centralized platforms for distributed test execution, customer test data creation tools, flaky test analytics and management, and GenAI-powered tooling that enable fast, trustworthy pre-production feedback.

We are part of a global, diverse organization that includes people of all genders, sexual orientations, upbringings, nationalities, ages, and socioeconomic & educational backgrounds. We encourage anyone passionate about developer platforms and testing infrastructure to apply.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to build developer-facing infrastructure and tooling that scales to millions of test runs per month. You will design and operate language-agnostic systems - spanning distributed execution infrastructure, telemetry and GenAI-powered developer tooling that make pre-production feedback testing fast and trustworthy.

 

Our ideal candidate is passionate about developer productivity and thrives on the satisfaction of empowering Commerce Engineering engineers worldwide to quickly and comprehensively test their software. They are excited to leverage their experience building and maintaining automated testing and resilience platforms to provide long-term benefits.

Key responsibilities

Primary stack: Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, GraphQL, GitHub Actions. You’ll work alongside test frameworks (JEST, Mocha, Playwright) through platform integration work - but you won’t author or maintain test suites yourself

  • Implement and manage software solutions that provide accurate and efficient analysis of test runs

  • Create and maintain tools for framework-agnostic analysis of distributed tracing tools for test runs

  • Stay informed about industry trends and emerging technologies - particularly GenAI applied to developer platforms - to ensure Commerce Engineering remains at the forefront of testing infrastructure

  • Develop and integrate software solutions that provide high-quality synthetic test data generation

  • Integrate internal and vendor-provided distributed test execution infrastructure into engineering workflows with a focus on reliability and ease of use

  • Develop the tools, frameworks and infrastructure that product engineers use to exercise frontend and backend systems - distributed tests execution, mocking, synthetic data, contract verification and performance harness

  • Design and operate the systems to automatically detect, quarantine, and self-heal flaky tests - turning noise into an actionable signal for engineers, with GenAI-assisted diagnosis

  • Correlate test coverage data with code changes, runtime execution, and trace data for comprehensive reporting

  • Maintain a strong focus on scalability, usability, and reliability in platform design to support a growing organization of stunning engineers

  • Define testing strategies in partnership with cross-functional teams - producing documentation on frameworks and troubleshooting patterns that internal teams rely on

Must Haves

  • A stunning software engineer with experience working on developer platform, platform services, or productivity-tooling teams - energized by unblocking other engineers and amplifying their throughput

  • A meticulous software designer who researches and documents technical tradeoffs clearly and concisely

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, service design, and automation platforms (CI/CD, test orchestration)

  • Hands-on GenAI fluency - daily use in your engineering workflow, plus experience shipping LLM-powered systems, ideally for developer users

  • Ability to independently drive organization-wide solutions and manage complex technical projects from conception to completion

  • Ability to synthesize complex technical information and communicate it effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Experience establishing strong testing culture, including proficiency with popular test frameworks, code coverage tools, continuous integration systems, and post-deployment verification methods (healthy contempt for flaky tests is a plus)

Nice To Haves

  • You have shipped and maintained Java, JavaScript or Python code in production

  • You have designed and implemented metrics data pipelines

  • Experience running and operating continuous integration systems like GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI and others 

  • Guide the roadmaps of Infrastructure teams according to the specific needs and requirements of product-focused team members

  • You have generated and analyzed traces like Distributed tracing/ Zipkin/ Honeycomb/ Datadog/ Splunk/ Elastic Search APM

  • You have implemented advanced log, metric, or error stack trace analysis

  • You strive to elevate the knowledge and skills of yourself and others in a way that fosters an inclusive, collaborative environment. Deeply enjoy working on solutions that empower other engineers in their work

  • Thrive in an ambiguous environment and can self-manage and self-prioritize your time, energy, and resources

  • Understand that engineering is a team sport and actively farm for feedback and dissent

  • Experience working with a globally distributed team

About the Data Science and Engineering organization:

Data Science and Engineering (DSE) is a key pillar of Netflix’s data-driven strategy, leveraging data, analytics, experimentation, models, and consumer insights to inform decisions. DSE focuses on data engineering, metrics, analysis, dashboards, analytic tools, experimentation research, and analytics. The team also develops models and algorithms for internal decision support.

We are committed to using data to inform our decision-making as we work toward our mission. This involves curating data across various domains, such as Growth, Finance, Product, Content, and Studio. All of this data collection and curation is made possible thanks to Netflix’s talented Data Engineers, who bring this data to life.

About Data Engineering:

Data Engineering at Netflix involves building systems to process data efficiently and modeling data to power analytics. These solutions range from batch data pipelines that bring business metrics to life, to real-time processing services that integrate with our core product features. Data Engineers benefit from a strong understanding of large distributed systems on which our data solutions rely. Candidates should have experience across several of these skill sets and depth in at least one area. Effective communication skills are important, as you will collaborate with business, engineering, and data science teams to foster a culture of learning.

We are hiring for the first time for the Data Engineering organization in EMEA, across the following teams:

Conversation, Marketing, and Fandom

The reach of Netflix and the fandom we create fuels the “Netflix effect” - a virtuous cycle of great content and intense fandom that catapults our stories into the cultural conversation. Netflix influences what people around the world search for and talk about, the music they listen to, the books they read, the countries they visit, and how they dress. 

Our marketing efforts help to kick start the Netflix effect, and we are providing more and more ways for fans to engage with our stores: Tudum, events like Netflix Bites and Bridgerton experiences, and the launch in 2025 of the first two Netflix House locations. 

Netflix is a data-driven company, and we are hiring multiple data engineers to increase our data support for marketing and fandom activities around the world. The opportunity for impact in these roles is enormous: Netflix social media channels generate more than 100B impressions a year, we are expanding fandom into the real world, and we’ve barely scratched the surface of the data available to support these activities.

Member Data Engineering

The Netflix product experience helps our members discover the next great piece of content to enjoy.  It could be a new series, an old movie, a live event people are talking about, or even a new video game. The product aims to present the right content, in the right format, to the right people, at the right time. When we do this well, Members value Netflix and continue to subscribe, despite the many other choices for entertainment. This team creates the data products that help measure this experience, track key metrics, and support innovation decisions through A/B testing.  You will partner closely with engineering teams to refine the client and server logging that serves as a foundation for our analytic datasets, and work closely with Data Scientists and Product Managers using this data to identify new opportunities and test out new ideas.  

What have you done and what do you know? 

  • 6 years of experience building data pipelines in batch and/or real-time settings to support a variety of use cases. Our data sources vary in size, from smaller sources to very large sources. Experience with Spark, Flink, Iceberg, and Kafka is helpful but not strictly required.

  • Proficiency in Python and/or Scala for scripting, automation, and data orchestration frameworks, as well as the ability to write complex SQL (any variant) for ad-hoc and recurring workflows. You strive to write clear and maintainable code and are comfortable learning new technologies.

  • Ability to model data efficiently for reporting and metrics, and to organize data for scale and fast retrieval.

  • Experience sourcing and modeling data from application APIs and event streams.

  • Experience converting business requirements into data engineering workstreams, enabling insights that empower colleagues to make informed decisions.

  • Experience mentoring and supporting other team members, navigating ambiguity, and creating clarity.

What will you do?

  • Take ownership of critical pipelines and data sets to support a variety of use cases in data science and engineering.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand needs, model tables using data warehouse best practices, and develop data pipelines to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality data.

  • Creatively explore how to use data to continually add value to Netflix. Translate ambiguous business questions into clear data requirements, and deliver on them.

  • Serve as a connector between data engineering and the business, enabling insights that empower colleagues to make informed decisions.

  • Build strong partnerships with data scientists, analytics engineers, and machine learning practitioners to enable research and insight delivery for the business.

Who are you? 

  • Able to work both independently and collaboratively across functions (e.g., data scientists, product managers).

  • Able to adapt to different work environments and see yourself as a partner in the business, with the shared goal of moving it forward.

  • You have a growth mindset, are curious, authentic, self-motivated, determined, and generous in giving and receiving feedback to foster growth for yourself and those around you.

  • Open to new perspectives, able to engage in thoughtful discussions, and adapt as new information emerges.

  • An effective communicator who can break down and explain complex data problems in clear, concise language
